welcome.title: Welcome to Crypto Portfolio Manager
welcome.subtitle: Onboarding & Quick Start Guide
welcome.intro: Monitor trading performance, balances, active positions, funding fees, order history, and transaction logs across Bitget, Bybit, and OKX in one unified terminal.
welcome.privacyWarning: Your API credentials are saved strictly in your browser's localStorage using zero-trust encryption. Communication with the exchanges occurs directly from your browser. Always use READ-ONLY API keys.
welcome.feature0Desc: Create read-only API keys on your exchanges, or try the platform without credentials by toggling Simulation Mode under Settings.
welcome.feature1Desc: Track unified balances, positions, margin ratios, and view advanced analytics like Funding Fees, Order Reports, and PnL charts.
welcome.feature2Desc: Connect exchanges via the API Keys page. All credentials are encrypted with your master passphrase locally in the browser.
welcome.feature3Desc: Click the Eye Icon in the header to toggle Privacy Mode. This hides balance, size, and PnL values for safe public sharing or streaming.
welcome.feature4Desc: Histories and currency rates operate on a background cache. Customize update intervals under the Settings page.
welcome.feature5Desc: Install the application as a Progressive Web App (PWA) on your mobile or desktop device for a native experience.
welcome.disclaimerDesc: This application unifies balances from various exchanges in one place. As each exchange has specific calculation methods, data presented may differ slightly from the official exchange site.
